Strategy: Double-capacity preference. Prefer bins that can still hold another item of the same size after placement, choosing the roomiest among them; otherwise rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest fit cannot hold a second same-size item but a roomier bin can. It may help by keeping one bin able to pair two similar items while preserving tight bins, but may fail if the next items are much smaller, making the preserved room unnecessary.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [r if r - item >= item else -(r - item) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Double-capacity preference: roomiest bin that still fits another same-size item, else Best Fit.
